description:
"Surround yourself in a phantasmic aura to gain Major Evasion, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.

Activating this ability removes all snares and immobilizations from you and grants immunity to them for |cffffff4|r seconds.

While active, taking direct damage reduces the cost of your next Roll Dodge by |cffffff10|r%, up to a maximum of |cffffff100|r%. This effect can stack up to once every half second."
